description: This file defines a utility class 'GLToolbox' for handling common OpenGL ES 2.0 operations in Android, such as shader compilation, program creation, error checking, and texture parameter initialization.

classes.name: GLToolbox
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for shader compilation, program linking, error checking, and texture parameter setup in OpenGL ES 2.0 for Android.

methods.name: loadShader
methods.description: Compiles a shader of the given type ('vertex' or 'fragment') from source code, throws RuntimeException if compilation fails.

methods.name: createProgram
methods.description: Creates an OpenGL shader program by compiling vertex and fragment shaders from source code, linking them, and returning the program ID.

methods.name: checkGlError
methods.description: Checks for OpenGL errors and throws RuntimeException if any are found.

methods.name: initTexParams
methods.description: Initializes texture parameters for linear filtering and clamp-to-edge wrapping.
